scope.summary: Prove the end-to-end professional Tailor workflow: body/pose, pattern authoring, drape, fit QA, material/UV, animation, versioned publish, Blender/UE round trip, recovery, and no-context replay.
acceptance_criteria: The workflow uses only documented commands/MCP/Argus and records every authoritative/derived version and receipt.
Cancellation, crash recovery, failed-export retry, stale dependency, and concurrent proposal paths are included.
Release success requires numerical, visual, accessibility, performance, publish-validation, and downstream round-trip gates.

The native E2E drives the authoritative handshake_core workflow through the shared command registry and retains the MT-708 Argus screenshot, AccessKit, renderer-error, layout, focus, and command-trace evidence matrix.
Every cloth/body/camera/contact/animation/import/export boundary in this proof consumes MT-656 typed units exactly once and includes negative mixed-unit and double-conversion rows.
scope.risk_if_missed: Subsystem tests can all pass while the real artist/model production loop breaks at an integration seam.

argus_targets: every control and visible state introduced or changed by this MT, using stable native author_id values

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The implementing MT emits or projects its applicable Tailor lifecycle, command, job, validation, or authority event through the shared Flight Recorder contract; pure solver kernels surface typed receipts through their owning run.
The shared internal_diagnostics substrate is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; use its open projection contract and do not fork a Tailor-only diagnostics runtime.
The shared Palmistry watcher is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; long-running Tailor jobs inherit bounded child-stall and survivor coverage during the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
Two proof commands are intentional: backend authority and native operator/model workflow are independent acceptance surfaces and both must pass.
